item.title: Second Half Time
item.description: A quick update of whats going on, wait what really is going on huh. weeks, maybe even months pass without posting anything. Honestly I also don’t know what to say, much/not much has been going on in life, just the same old work-home routine. Well I started reading a book, Atomic Habits, maybe that’s something. My thoughts on the book so far, great opening at each level, i honestly thought the book will be much more heavy on the mind in terms of the words and school of thought but now i can see why its like a fun favourite. I believe anyone can easily relate to it even when they don’t have a history of reading big books. I will give a better review once am done reading the book. ![[atomic_habits_art.png]] And with work, I’ve been gaining quality experience, the other 2 development projects i started with have since then gone on halt but I’ve been working on the development of a E-registry system. I don’t know if i mentioned, i coded(still coding) a mid-level SaaS in elixir, both front and back-end. LOB exam Scheduler, haven’t updated anything on the code base in day but I will be returning and today i generated a new java project, just to sharpen my java, I’ve played enough with elixir its about time I see some Java coffee, more on the project in my next post.

item.title: Weekend After Exams Week
item.description: Just finished writing my end of semester exams for year 3 semester 2, this marked the end of my 3rd year and marking the beginning of my final year next time we open. I am looking forward to the final school year, and all the opportunities and learning it will bring with it. My my internship at Probase still going, I official ran and entire semester of school on DL(Distance learning) and I’d say it wast that rough, tho yes the final exams where kinda tough but that’s how all final exams are. Overall great experience hoping to see great results when the marking is done

item.title: Catching Up – Long Rollercoster Of Grind
item.description:
It’s been a while since I last shared anything here, and honestly, a lot has happened since last time I posted in February.

After that point, life picked up pace quickly. I’ve been juggling multiple things—school, projects, and personal growth. This semester has been intense, with Computer Science classes pushing me harder than ever, especially Data Structures & Algorithms and Enterprise Networking. I’ve been trying to stay afloat, learning and unlearning so much in the process.
